QUOTE: Accumulates, same as tier 3 ... "you can correct our guesses; you cannot un-discover a fact."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says tiers 3 and 4 accumulate the same way, but it never says the distinction between them is deliberately inert, and it never names fact-versus-guess as the load-bearing line (the closest it gets is the "un-discover a fact" aphorism).
